description: This file implements command handling logic for executing and managing bash commands within a chat environment, including parsing commands, managing active jobs, and interfacing with external tools for process execution.

methods.name: resolveForegroundMs
methods.description: Determines the foreground timeout in milliseconds based on configuration, with default fallback.

methods.name: formatSessionSnippet
methods.description: Creates a shortened representation of a session ID for display.

methods.name: formatOutputBlock
methods.description: Formats output text into a code block or indicates no output.

methods.name: parseBashRequest
methods.description: Parses raw command input into a structured BashRequest object.

methods.name: resolveRawCommandBody
methods.description: Extracts and processes the command body from the message context, considering group or individual context.

methods.name: getScopedSession
methods.description: Retrieves session information if it belongs to the specific scope key.

methods.name: ensureActiveJobState
methods.description: Checks and maintains the current active bash job state.

methods.name: attachActiveWatcher
methods.description: Attaches a watcher to monitor the lifecycle of a running bash session.

methods.name: buildUsageReply
methods.description: Constructs a reply payload with usage instructions for the bash command.

methods.name: handleBashChatCommand
methods.description: Main function to handle chat commands related to bash execution, including parsing, starting, polling, and stopping jobs.

methods.name: resetBashChatCommandForTests
methods.description: Resets the active job state, primarily for testing purposes.
